Conservation silver + rejets = bronze, mesurée sur silver ; consolidation gold mesurée par xref

crm.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL OR u.cli_id IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.xref_identifiants x LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique u ON u.cli_id=x.cli_id LEFT JOIN silver.client s ON s.silver_row_id=x.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id AND s.source_systeme=x.source_systeme AND s.source_id=x.source_id AND s._batch_id=:lot LEFT JOIN bronze.crm_client b ON b.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id AND b.client_id=x.source_id AND b._batch_id=:lot WHERE x.source_systeme=:origine

cif.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL OR u.cli_id IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.xref_identifiants x LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique u ON u.cli_id=x.cli_id LEFT JOIN silver.client s ON s.silver_row_id=x.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id AND s.source_systeme=x.source_systeme AND s.source_id=x.source_id AND s._batch_id=:lot LEFT JOIN bronze.cif_clients b ON b.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id AND b.column0=x.source_id AND b._batch_id=:lot WHERE x.source_systeme=:origine

contrat_certifie.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.contrat_certifie g LEFT JOIN silver.contrat s ON s.silver_row_id=g.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND s._batch_id=g._batch_id LEFT JOIN bronze.crm_contrat b ON b.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND b._batch_id=g._batch_id AND b.contrat_id=g.contrat_id WHERE g._batch_id=:lot

sinistre_certifie.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.sinistre_certifie g LEFT JOIN silver.sinistre s ON s.silver_row_id=g.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND s._batch_id=g._batch_id LEFT JOIN bronze.crm_sinistre b ON b.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND b._batch_id=g._batch_id AND b.sinistre_id=g.sinistre_id WHERE g._batch_id=:lot

BRONZE.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT souscripteur_id) FROM bronze.crm_contrat WHERE _batch_id=:lot AND date_debut<=:ref AND date_fin>=:ref AND date_derniere_cotisation>=:cot

SILVER.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT souscripteur_id) FROM silver.contrat WHERE _batch_id=:lot AND date_debut<=:ref AND date_fin>=:ref AND date_derniere_cotisation>=:cot
